description:
Fetch a single webhook endpoint by its numeric id, including its signing secret and delivery health (consecutive failures, last success/failure) (its secret is withheld on this server).

On this server a secret field in the result is withheld: a secret leaves this server only in the result of a money tool, which the client asks the user to approve (for a webhook, rotate_webhook_secret); the account holder also sees it at https://porkbun.com/account/api.

id.description: The webhook endpoint id (from list_webhooks or create_webhook).

name: get_webhook
